== Build notes ==
* Decklists: a DeckTech deck is listed only when its own post (title, description or strategy) says it was built for this format ("Type II", "type 2", "EP1", "E1", "Episode 1 only", "closed environment"). "No R3" alone, or a deck that only uses Episode I cards, does not qualify. 43 of 470 live DeckTech decks qualify (scan 17 October 2026).
* Card counts per set come from the PC card JSON (cards with the Episode I icon in sets 11–14, Decipher printings only).
* Deck pages keep their own Format cell ([[Premiere - Coruscant]], [[Premiere - Reflections III]] or [[Premiere - Original VS1]]); this list does not change them.

== Possibly faulty data ==
* [[Gregory Malysa Senate Podracing Party]] runs [[Battle Plan & •Draw Their Fire|Battle Plan & Draw Their Fire]], which has no Episode I icon. Listed as posted.
* Several decks resolve generic posted names (Sense, Alter, Control, Tatooine, Coruscant, Tusken Raider, Proton Torpedoes, Obi-Wan's Lightsaber) to non-Episode I printings; the posts are for this format, so the Coruscant, Reflections III or Theed Palace printings are likely meant.

== Missing data ==
* Decipher's format page (www.decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/episodei.html, named on the Reflections III rulesheet) has no Wayback capture found. Prize foil titles and event dates are not sourced.

== Marginal cuts ==
* [[Dunya Ertan Invasion]] (DeckTech 20552, 10 January 2002) says only "its a ep 1 deck". It runs Twi'lek Advisor, Battle Deployment and non-icon Reflections III shields, so it is not listed.
